name: forecast-chart
title: Forecast chart
description: Solid line for what happened, dashed line inside a shaded band for what is expected. The band is the likely range.
htmlExample:
<bef-forecast-chart class="w-[36rem] max-w-full" :labels='["Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec","Jan","Feb"]' :actual="[42,48,45,58,63,61,72]" :forecast="[76,81,84,90]" :low="[72,74,74,77]" :high="[80,88,94,103]" id="g1"></bef-forecast-chart>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  format: (n) => `₹${n}L`,
};
</script>
